configuration.workload_mode: sequential tracked local writes followed by one batch synchronization

metric_definitions.scr: Both replicas' conflict-row values compared with independently calculated base + delta_a + delta_b.
metric_definitions.rvar: Agreement on ordered bench_rows.value vectors only; not database convergence.
metric_definitions.timing: Write samples are per local mutation; batch_sync_ms excludes setup and writes.
metric_definitions.comparison: Paired sync timing compares engine INCREMENT with direct application additive merge only; LWW is a semantic contrast and excluded from paired timing claims.
